assumptions: Anchor 'center' is used because boxes are top-down with centre as metric position, while bottom_center is downstream AABB edge not ground contact.
'stop_zone' (last 10 m before the line) is taken to represent 'at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line'.
Inbound crossing (+y from y<0.6 to y>0.6) is encoded as direction 'to_right' per line definition; only inbound crossings trigger the requirement.
'shall stop' is interpreted as stopped (max_speed 0.05) for at least 1000 ms; the statute states no duration so 1000 ms is assumed minimum detectable stop.
'Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal' is omitted because officer direction and signal state are not visible to the camera.
Vehicles that never cross the stop line inbound vacuously pass.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must first dwell stopped in the stop zone for at least 1000 ms.

provenance.reason: Statute says 'approaching' but not encoded direction; line definition maps inbound +y crossing to to_right, so inbound is used.
Statute states 'shall stop' with no duration; 1000 ms assumed as minimum reliably detectable complete stop.
Boxes are top-down with centre as metric position; bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not ground contact, so center matches zone/line drawing.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
